type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M),
  ResiduesFinite M →
    ∀ (φ : ↥M.K),
      Transcendental ℚ φ →
        ∀ (K : CanonicalDivisorData M hDVR),
          ∃ q,
            q ≠ 0 ∧
              ∀ (P : Place ↥M.K),
                K.D P = (if φ ∈ ↑P then ramIdx M hDVR φ P - 1 else -ramIdx M hDVR φ P - 1) + ord M hDVR P q
